decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the tribute page placement towards the end; no additional update or removal is required.
Adding a tribute page does not necessarily change the author-name or author-photo rules for articles.

The supplied tribute page does not alter the requirement to request supplemental images when needed for article layout balance.
The tribute page changes issue content, not the requirement to deliver a flipbook-ready digital PDF.

Adding the tribute page does not change the digital launch target or deadline.
